summary: Count actual alternates before emitting the 'no alternate subject/catalog number' note, and mark a CCN-formatted catalog number as ccn=true even when its subject is not flagged (CCN).
reason: `ccn ENGL 101 --college ELAC --term 2268` returned the correct equivalent (ENGL C1000, 20 sections, 16 open) and then appended a note saying no alternate exists. The guard fired on len(Equivalents) <= 1, which assumes the first row is always the queried course itself; that is false exactly when the portal has already renumbered the course, which is the case this command exists to handle. The row also reported ccn=false because the portal only marks the *subject* as '(CCN)', not the catalog number.
validated_outcome: `ccn ENGL 101 --college ELAC --term 2268` now returns ENGL C1000 with ccn=true and no contradictory note; the note still fires when no alternate subject/catalog exists. Full Go suite passes.
